propositions: git commit --amend -F <file> replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amend with -F from a fresh commit with -F, because Git does not provide that context to the hook
a make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper should amend HEAD while preserving the existing Change-Id trailer by extracting it before the amend and restoring it with git interpret-trailers
the wrapper must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id, rather than producing a commit that will receive a fresh Change-Id

AGENTS.md documentation must be updated to name make amend-msg as the required path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m and --amend -F drop the Change-Id and create duplicate changes
no pre-push hook, reflog comparison, or other guard should be implemented; the wrapper and documentation are the sole solution
